metadata.case_name: CHENG SAM PAK v. THE ATTORNEY GENERAL FOR HONG KONG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: loss of finger tips of the first to fourth fingers including nails of the right hand, with protrusion of the finger tip bones
source: loss of finger tips of the first to fourth fingers including nails of the right hand, with protrusion of the finger tip bones;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: superficial laceration over the right palm and the third web
source: superficial laceration over the right palm and the third web
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of other parts of wrist or hand

manifestations.description: numbness of the tips of the 4 injured fingers
reduced strength in the grip of the right hand
reduced length of the right thumb and right index, middle and ring fingers
scars at the sites of the injuries (which are at the tips of the said fingers)
right hand would feel cold if temperature is low
when the weather changes, the stump of the thumb and the fingers would be painful and swollen
pain, anguish, fearfulness, nightmares and disturbed sleep immediately after the injuries
long-term adverse effects on his socialisation skills and self-esteem due to his awareness of the cosmesis of the injured hand
socially withdrawn and became more housebound
hypersensitivity at the scars, especially for the middle and ring fingers
poor in manipulating fine objects and poor in lifting, carrying, pulling or pushing heavy objects (unable to manipulate fine objects)
awareness of his deformities and regarded it as a social handicap

treatments_received: revision amputations of the second to fourth fingers
suturing of the lacerations of the right palm and third web
stitches removed the day after the operation
re-admitted for removal of a foreign body nodule formed between the web the 4th and 5th fingers

losses.description: Loss of fingertips of first to fourth right-hand fingers, reduced grip strength, numbness and reduced length of digits
Cosmetic disfigurement and visible scarring at the tips of the injured fingers
Social withdrawal, became more housebound and adverse effects on socialisation skills and self-esteem
Diminished marriage prospects (judge noted conceivable some females may initially find his right hand unpleasant to look at)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty manipulating fine objects and reduced ability in lifting, carrying, pulling or pushing

comparable_cases.injury_description: right hand crushed in a power press and 3 of his fingers were amputated
injuries considered relatively minor (context: finger injuries)
